classifications.contract: Version/type/compatibility rules; changing these changes accepted data or reader semantics.
classifications.identity: Stable IDs used for reference, provenance and continuation.
classifications.presentation: Human-facing inert labels/copy/colors with no sporting authority.
classifications.reference: References resolved and type-checked before activation.
classifications.authoring: Authoring inputs that become ordinary validated domain data before runtime.
classifications.sporting: Rules, allocations or session/competition policy that can change legal race behavior.
classifications.simulation: Numeric/model inputs consumed by the authoritative simulation or geometry.
classifications.safety: Bounds/clamps whose primary role is keeping runtime state inside validated operating limits.
